units.rawText: Ah, you, I remember you. It was a lot of trouble doing the emergency repairs, especially those little guys.
units.displayText: Ah, you, I remember you. It was a lot of trouble doing the emergency repairs, especially those little guys.

spans.text: Ah, you, I remember you. It was a lot of trouble doing the emergency repairs, especially those little guys.

spans.text: Thank you for your efforts... I wanted to ask, what exactly happened back then?

units.rawText: You were brought along by some people and sold off for a measly price. Going by their looks, they were probably the underlings of someone with some serious money, but who exactly, I don't know.

units.rawText: Yeah... We've lost at least a few weeks of memory data.

units.rawText: I see. I'm not sure then; it might've been the damage. You took a lot of effort, and a bunch of parts were damn difficult to find. We had to call in a few emergency orders.

units.displayText: The bill... Please give it to me.

units.rawText: Huh? You serious? This is a big sum of money, and someone else's already paid it off. What are you going to do with it, pay her back?

units.rawText: You little simpletons, what is there to be happy about? We've been well and truly thrown away this time. Even if we return to the stage, the audience will be those same people who discarded us.
